ts_current_ui_gap.evidence: Only ShippingTemplatePicker selection plus router.push(/shipping-templates); no selected-template detail/edit/create modal retained in current editor.
Picker only hydrates selected id/name/type, searches/paginates choices, chooses/clears; does not expose actual grouped template view/author.

preserve_contracts: Template save is an independent real write; opening/cancelling template editor performs no product POST. Unsaved product main fields, exact SKU object/ids/prices/inventory, description/media intents and metadata selections must survive a successful or cancelled modal operation.

Opening existing template requires existing supplier.shipping.view and own owner2/relation; modifying/creating requires supplier.shipping.manage. Product manage alone must not acquire shipping edit rights.
Keep shipping-v1 expectedRevision, grouped rule bounds, region authority, independent per-owner lifecycle locks, UUID creation/receipt/unknown recovery; no new production grants/DDL/FK.

Successful template edit rereads authoritative detail/revision and refreshes directory/current-name evidence. Do not silently alter current product temp_id or replace product draft on metadata refresh. PHP only refreshes parent directory; selecting a new template should be explicit.

Route/context generation, identity/capability ABA, unmount and aborted queued transport must stop late dialog/directory results from authoring another product. Unknown creation must retain its original mature key/payload and scope instead of allowing another create.

Editing a shared existing template legitimately affects every product bound to it; communicate this existing effect and preserve final checkout snapshot revalidation. Do not add new pricing, stock, unit, membership or order-answer policy.
Copy retains the existing safe temp_id contract and creation/recovery protocol; no hidden copy-field expansion.
Raw PHP lacks TS ownership/revision safety; preserve TS stricter authenticated owner rules rather than copying old insecure id-only edit behavior.

frontend: Mount actual ProductForm plus shared real template editor; dirty name/unit/SKU price/media/description/select fields, open selected template, cancel and confirm complete product draft unchanged with zero product writes.
Edit a real owned template in place, save through actual existing transport, reread its revision/rules, refresh picker name/type, assert existing product draft and selected temp_id unchanged.

Create inside modal with mature UUID receipt and explicit acknowledge/selection; lost response or receipt absence freezes original creation intent; no duplicate create after reopen/route or actor change.

Read-only shipping view can inspect but cannot send template writes; product-only manager cannot call shipping manage; route80→81→80, identity21→22→21, queued transport/unmount and directory failures never mutate another entry.
native: Real App/JWT independent Supplier LOGIN edits an owned template, full grouped readback and revision checked; another Supplier/foreign/missing id indistinguishable refusal, stale revision409 with no partial product/template/history effects.

Use existing real quote fixture plus lifecycle commissioner; before publishing ordinary product bind template with first1/price8/continue1/price2; separate actual Admin review; Customer confirm quantity2 reads postage10. Edit only template first_price to12; fresh confirm becomes14. Keep global free-shipping/member/coupon fixtures explicit to isolate the template policy.

Old quote/create after template change must retain mature invalidation behavior and rollback with no duplicate stock/order work; fresh quote→real Customer create freezes new postage. Existing historical order/line snapshots stay unchanged.

Do not claim inventory unchanged across a successful real order creation: assert zero inventory/ledger changes during template authoring, then exact mature stock/order effects in separately baselined checkout stage.
browser: Use production Supplier bundle and owned real API/PG, keep unsaved product draft while viewing/editing/creating template within current product entry; actual cancel and positive readback checkpoints.
If actual Customer H5 confirm/create is included, use real local Customer/JWT/quote; otherwise state Browser tests author workflow and Native owns actual checkout consumer proof.
